paul_sales: Quick Q from Acme: they want the POC isolated. They asked whether we prefer VPC peering, TGW, or PrivateLink for the minimal flow. They also want a one-page action list to hand to their infra team.

anya_se: Short guidance: PrivateLink is simplest for control-plane/API isolation (no route changes required). TGW/peering needed only if they must route traffic into our workload VPCs or want L7 traffic to traverse a shared network. For speed, PrivateLink wins.

sam_net: Networking bits for customer to follow (minimal):
- Confirm their VPC CIDR and ensure no overlap with our infra (ours: 10.250.0.0/16).
- Provide 1 private subnet ID per AZ where they want ENIs. Recommend /24 subnets.
- Create Interface Endpoint using svc name we give and share VPCE IDs.
- If they prefer TGW: create cross-account IAM role with trust to our account and run CreateTransitGatewayVpcAttachment, then share attachment ID.

kim_sre: Security & routes:
- SG on endpoint: inbound 443 from app subnets, outbound 443 to our control-plane CIDRs.
- If TGW used, add explicit static route in their route tables pointing to the TGW attachment for our infra CIDR. Example: Destination 10.250.0.0/16 -> TransitGateway tgw-zzzz1111.

anya_se: Small CLI snippets for them to copy:
- Create VPCE (customer account):
  aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-0aaa --vpc-endpoint-type Interface --service-name com.amazonaws.vpce.us-west-2.vpce-svc-EXAMPLE --subnet-ids subnet-111 subnet-222 --security-group-ids sg-aaa

- If TGW path: customer creates attachment (customer acct):
  aws ec2 create-transit-gateway-vpc-attachment --transit-gateway-id tgw-zzzz1111 --vpc-id vpc-0aaa --subnet-ids subnet-111 subnet-222

kim_sre: DNS note: to make our hostnames resolve privately enable Private DNS on the VPCE or add private Route53 A records pointing to ENI IPs. Without this, calls will go out to public endpoints.

sam_net: Few gotchas from past POCs:
- Small subnets (/28) run out of ENI IPs quickly; avoid them.
- Corporate egress filters can break TLS/SNI; ask them to test directly from an EC2 when debugging.
- If they pick TGW and also have VPNs, check for overlapping /32 routes from appliances that may take precedence.

anya_se: Pricing snippet for sales to tell customer: Dedicated-managed POC (we host reserved pool) is fastest to stand up and we handle infra. Private (customer-managed VPC) gives more control but needs infra time and a short license. We'll loop in sales-ops for exact numbers.

infra-bot: :white_check_mark: Created ticket POC-3229. Attach VPCE IDs or TGW attachment ID here when ready.

paul_sales: Thanks team 14 I'll forward this as a one-pager. I'll ask Acme which connectivity they prefer (PrivateLink vs TGW) and request subnet IDs. Will post back VPCE/attachment IDs when they reply. :rocket:
